description:
Your organization's compliance team requires a new Call Time restriction in Vicidial to ensure outbound calls comply with TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) regulations for campaigns targeting the Eastern US Time Zone.

Log in to the Vicidial Admin panel at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php (username: 6666, password: andromeda) and create a new Call Time with the following exact specifications:

- Call Time ID: EASTERN_TCPA
- Call Time Name: Eastern US TCPA Compliant Hours
- Call Time Comments: TCPA compliant calling window for Eastern Time Zone campaigns. No Sunday calling. Reduced Saturday hours.

Day-specific calling windows (in military HHMM format):
- Default Start: 0800, Default Stop: 2100
- Sunday: Start 0, Stop 0 (no calling allowed on Sundays)
- Monday: Start 0800, Stop 2100
- Tuesday: Start 0800, Stop 2100
- Wednesday: Start 0800, Stop 2100
- Thursday: Start 0800, Stop 2100
- Friday: Start 0800, Stop 2100
- Saturday: Start 0900, Stop 1700

To access Call Times, navigate to Admin > Call Times in the Vicidial administration interface. You may need to first create the call time entry (specifying the ID and name), and then modify it on the detail/edit page to configure all day-specific start and stop values. Make sure to submit/save after setting all values.
